answer: A falcon-like verifier randomly audits a sample each epoch, and any duplicate device fingerprint triggers slashing plus a jetty-style quarantine that blocks the offender from transacting until peers re-attest. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity anchored to a physical knoll of registered hardware: each agent must bond collateral tied to a unique attested device, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital per node. Adversaries thus face rising marginal cost per sybil, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent once0002's threat model.
